title: Galaxy
definition: A galaxy is a massive, gravitationally bound system consisting of stars, stellar remnants, interstellar gas, dust, and dark matter, held together by mutual gravitational attraction.
importanceInUpsc: Essential for UPSC CSE Prelims (Cosmic Physics, Astronomy, Space Missions) and Mains GS Paper III (Science & Technology - Awareness in the fields of Space and Astrophysics).
learningOutcomes: Master foundational concepts and morphological classifications of galaxies.
Evaluate spatial distribution, Local Group dynamics, and cosmic evolution.
Apply high-yield mnemonics to solve tricky Prelims and Mains questions.
prerequisites: Stellar evolution and life cycle of stars
